# SpaceWish / Желание сквозь Вселенную

> SpaceWish is a Russian-language project about creating a personal digital message package for a future confirmed space radio transmission. The current website is an MVP and does not claim that a real transmission has already occurred.

## Canonical site
- https://spacewish.agency/

## Knowledge topics
- radio signals and space communication
- interstellar messages
- SETI and METI
- EEG / electroencephalography
- Arecibo message
- Voyager Golden Record
- light-years and signal travel time
- radio telescopes and NASA Deep Space Network
- Proxima Centauri, TRAPPIST-1, HD 20794, Sirius, Polaris

## Important factual boundaries
- The current MVP creates a preliminary digital package only.
- A real transmission site, date, frequency, power, antenna and session parameters must be treated as unconfirmed until the technical operator confirms them.
- EEG is not described as reading the semantic content of thoughts.
- SpaceWish does not sell ownership of stars and does not claim official star naming rights.
- A selected star is a symbolic/astronomical direction for a message.
- No reply from extraterrestrial intelligence is promised or implied.

## Preferred source families for factual claims
- NASA / JPL
- SETI Institute
- NIH / NINDS
- International Astronomical Union
- ESA / official astronomy archives
